# Panorays

> > Panorays provides AI-powered third-party cyber risk management and attack surface management to help organizations assess, monitor, and remediate vendor security risks.

Panorays is a leading TPRM (Third-Party Risk Management) platform that uses Risk DNA technology to deliver comprehensive cybersecurity posture assessments and continuous monitoring. The platform helps CISOs and security teams manage third-party vendor risks across their supply chain with compliance automation and intelligent questionnaires.

## Key Topics

- Third-Party Cyber Risk Management
- TPRM (Third-Party Risk Management)
- TPCRM (Third-Party Cybersecurity Risk Management)
- Risk DNA
- Attack Surface Management
- Vendor Management
- Cyber Risk Assessment
- Supply Chain Security
- Compliance Monitoring
- Smart Questionnaire™
- Vulnerability Management
- Cyber Posture
- GDPR
- SOC 2
- AI-Powered Risk Intelligence

## Core Platform Features

- [Risk DNA: Comprehensive Cybersecurity Posture](https://panorays.com/platform/cybersecurity-posture): Risk DNA platform for comprehensive cybersecurity posture assessment
- [External Attack Surface Management Platform](https://panorays.com/platform/attack-surface-management): Attack surface management with vendor assessments and vulnerabilities
- [Third-Party Mgmt Cybersecurity Questionnaires](https://panorays.com/platform/cybersecurity-questionnaires): AI-driven cybersecurity questionnaires for vendor risk assessment
- [Inventory: Your Centralized Vendor Repository](https://panorays.com/inventory-centralized-vendor-repository): Inventory product for centralized vendor repository management
- [Continuous Cyber Security Monitoring](https://panorays.com/platform/cyber-security-monitoring): Continuous monitoring of third-party cyber threats and emerging risks
- [Third-Party Vendor Portfolio Management](https://panorays.com/platform/vendor-portfolio-management): Vendor portfolio management and supplier security segmentation

## Risk Management & Remediation

- [TPRM Communication, Collaboration, and Remediation](https://panorays.com/platform/communication): TPRM communication and collaboration features with Smart Questionnaire
- [Remediation Plans for Third-Party Vulnerabilities](https://panorays.com/platform/remediation): Customized remediation plans for third-party vulnerabilities
- [Compliance Regulation Management for Third-Parties](https://panorays.com/platform/regulatory-compliance): Vendor compliance assessment with GDPR, PCI DSS, and standards
- [Third-Party Risk Reporting and Dashboards](https://panorays.com/platform/reporting-and-dashboard): Third-party risk reporting and dashboards for stakeholders
